Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 29 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Neeta - 26 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sonali - 32 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Sunita - 64 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Rajesh stands in the office. Neeta and Sonali stand near him.]

Neeta: "Rajesh, what's the plan today?"

[Rajesh sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Neeta (happily): "I knew it!"

[Rajesh answers the phone at his desk.]

Neeta (gently): "Rajesh, are you okay?"

[Rajesh stretches after hours at the computer.]

Sonali: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rajesh presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Rajesh: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Rajesh stands on the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Rajesh: "So, here we are!"

[Rajesh starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Sonali (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Rajesh is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Rajesh: "Yes, of course."

[Rajesh steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Rajesh: "What a day to remember!"
